mechanism_claims.claim_text: c-LA-RWR and LA-RWR-PEA have direct membrane-disruption evidence in E. coli assays: DiSC3(5) membrane-potential fluorescence increased rapidly at 2MIC, and NPN fluorescence supported outer-membrane permeability damage.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: c-LA-RWR and LA-RWR-PEA; c-LA-RWR-PEA also appears in the assay setup but the result text emphasizes c-LA-RWR/LA-RWR-PEA

target.strain: E. coli DC2 for depolarization; E. coli for NPN permeability

mechanism_claims.limitations: The assays support membrane-potential/permeability disruption, not a single molecular binding target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Time-kill, crystal-violet biofilm, and CLSM biofilm assays provide phenotype-supported antibacterial and antibiofilm activity for c-LA-RWR and LA-RWR-PEA at low 2MIC concentrations.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: LA-RWR, c-LA-RWR, LA-RWR-PEA, and c-LA-RWR-PEA where reported; result prose emphasizes c-LA-RWR and LA-RWR-PEA improvements over LA-RWR

target.species: Escherichia coli; Staphylococcus aureus; Candida albicans; MRSA

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=2.7; xml:sec=2.8; xml:sec=3.2; xml:sec=3.3; xml:fig=3; xml:fig=4; xml:fig=5

mechanism_claims.limitations: Biofilm and time-kill assays are phenotype evidence; exact figure-only bar values not stated in text are not overpromoted.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: SEM visualization showed membrane pores and cytoplasm outflow after E. coli and S. aureus exposure to c-LA-RWR or LA-RWR-PEA at 2MIC for 30 min, supporting physical cell-envelope damage.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: c-LA-RWR and LA-RWR-PEA compared with LA-RWR and untreated controls
mechanism_claims.limitations: SEM morphology supports membrane/cell-envelope damage but does not quantify a molecular target.
